svg.title: Sierpinski gasket monopole · iterations=3 — technical drawing
svg.desc: Sierpinski gasket monopole · iterations=3 (sierpinski-monopole) · Fairbeam 0.7.0 · third-angle projection · scale 2:1 · A3

g.text: 2. Metal parts are PEC; zero-thickness sheets are drawn with a minimum line width (solid black when seen edge-on).
3. Infinite PEC ground plane at z = 0 mm (boundary condition, image theory), shown as a hatched ground line.
4. P1: lumped port, 50 Ω, along z, gap 1 mm, excited.
